$meta.name: Troupe GUI design tokens
$meta.description: Design system for the Troupe browser client. Colour tokens carry dark and light values under the same semantic name; consumers switch by theme, never by picking a different token. Every token name states purpose, not hue.
$meta.notes: Amber (status.waiting) is reserved. It marks one thing only: work that is stopped and waiting for a human decision. Do not use it for branding, links, emphasis or decoration.

stage.description: Deepest ground. App shell behind everything.

canvas.description: Default reading surface. Conversation, page body.

panel.description: Structural region inside the canvas: backstage panel, list rows, sheets.

raised.description: Interactive element sitting on a panel: buttons, inputs, chips.

sunken.description: Recessed region: code, diffs, command blocks, toolbars.

hover.description: Pointer hover wash on any interactive surface.

selected.description: Persistent selected state for rows and tabs.

secondary.description: Supporting copy, metadata that still must be read.

muted.description: Timestamps, counts, non-essential detail. Never the only carrier of meaning.

inverse.description: Text on a filled accent surface.

link.description: Inline links in agent output and copy.

hairline.description: Default 1px separation between regions. The main structural device in this design.

strong.description: Emphasised edge: input borders, active row edge, table headers.

focus.description: Keyboard focus ring. Must clear 3:1 against both the element and its surroundings.

divider.description: Faint rule inside a panel, between items of one list.

running.description: An agent is working right now.

waiting.description: Stopped, waiting for a human decision. The only use of amber in the product.

queued.description: Accepted but not yet started: a queued message, a pending task.

allowed.description: A decision record: the action was permitted.

denied.description: A decision record: the action was refused. Not an error.

dormant.description: Session asleep. Costs nothing, wakes on the next message.

readonly.description: Access withdrawn or archived. Readable, not writable.

error.description: Something failed. Reserved for failure, never for denial.

private.description: Session that belongs to one person, not a team. Nobody else can open it and nobody can be added later. Cool slate, close to the chrome, because private is ordinary rather than alarming.

person.description: Attribution colours for people in a shared session. Assign by stable hash of user id. Amber is excluded because it belongs to approvals. Always paired with initials and a name, never colour alone.

self.description: The current user. Deliberately neutral so other people stand out.

agent.description: The troupe itself, not a person.

sans.description: Interface and reading. Chosen for a drafted, engineered tone and full Danish diacritic coverage.

mono.description: Anything literal: paths, commands, diffs, identifiers, timestamps in dense lists.

subheading.use: Group headings inside a panel, list section labels.

micro.use: Status pills, counts, relative times. Sentence case, never all caps.

codeSmall.use: Diff bodies and dense log output.

reading.description: Max line length for agent output and long copy.

radius.note: Deliberately tight. Structure comes from hairlines and alignment, not from rounding.

border.note: marker is the left edge that flags a row or panel as needing attention.

footlight.use: The approval panel only. A light thrown up from the stage edge.

rules: Every animation is idempotent: a server-driven DOM replacement may restart it at any time, and restarting must look acceptable.
No animation longer than duration.slow on anything that can be re-rendered by the stream.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses all durations to instant and replaces pulses with static marks.

min.description: Hard floor. Everything must work here.

md.description: Backstage becomes a side panel instead of a sheet.

lg.description: Session list rail appears beside the conversation.

touchTarget.description: Minimum hit area for anything tappable, approvals included.

switchTrack.description: Tool on/off switch track. Knob 18px, travel 18px.
